summary: Freightos Limited furnished a Form 6-K clarifying a typographical error in the form of proxy card (Exhibit 99.2) previously furnished November 4, 2026, for its 2026 Annual General Meeting scheduled December 16, 2026. The proxy card preamble inadvertently cited a November 9, 2026 record date; the Notice of AGM and distributed proxy cards correctly state the record date as close of business November 5, 2026. The company and transfer agent Continental Stock Transfer & Trust Company will tabulate strictly on the November 5 record date, and the erroneous reference carries no legal significance. No shareholder action is required. This is a routine meeting-administration notice, not a special situation; watch only for any further AGM-related corrections.
